sentences: This bill is part of a package that would make Australia Day a national day in federal law and set its date as 26 January.
It would also create a process for changing the date through a national plebiscite, with 26 January always an option for voters.
The same voters as in federal elections would be eligible to vote in any plebiscite on an alternative date.
changes: Establishes Australia Day as a national day in federal law.
Sets the date of Australia Day as 26 January.
Creates a process for changing the date through a national plebiscite.
Requires any plebiscite to include 26 January as an option.
Limits eligibility to vote in the plebiscite to those qualified for federal elections.
summary.affected: All Australians who are eligible to vote in federal elections.
